what: The known-truth cases of regbench: deformation families, amplitudes, scales, poses, window, probes, thresholds and the re-seed rule. Frozen before any method is scored; see truth.py. Version 3 (ruling of 2026-10-11, R3.11 e): a case whose true map folds is re-seeded. Version 2 (rulings of 2026-10-09, R3.6): seam block 1950 px, denser bumps, no patient named.

families.name: wave
families.note: amplitude and wavelength are the benchmark's choice

families.name: grid
families.note: literature value as recorded in STARE's README, not re-read

families.name: multiscale
families.note: amplitude: literature value as recorded in STARE's README, not re-read; the three scales and their equal energy are the benchmark's choice; fixed in micrometres

families.name: bumps100
families.note: the benchmark's choice; each bump peaks at 0.2 to 0.6 sigma. Measured on the generated field at n_px: 24 % of the window moves by more than 1 um (0.218 to 0.250 over 82 seeds); no fold in any of them (smallest Jacobian determinant 0.37); under the reseed rule like every continuous family

families.name: bumps25
families.note: outside STARE's model: finer than its vector lattice; each bump peaks at 0.2 to 0.6 sigma. Measured on the generated field at n_px: 23 % of the window moves by more than 1 um (0.229 to 0.237 over 182 seeds); the two synthetic cases do not fold (smallest Jacobian determinant 0.25 and 0.32 on a 4 px lattice). A fold is a rare coincidence of bumps (1 seed of 240 on a 4 px lattice, see reseed); such a seed is skipped by the reseed rule

families.name: seams
families.note: outside STARE's model: discontinuous. Seams in the n_px window at 1950, 3900, 5850 and 7800 px: none is a multiple of any size in method_grids_px

reseed.rule: a case of a listed family is made with the seed its seed_rule asks for only if the smallest Jacobian determinant of its true map (pose and field; central differences on a lattice every lattice_px px over the whole window) is above min_jacobian. Otherwise that seed is skipped and seed + step is measured, then seed + 2 step, up to max_tries seeds; if all fold the case is refused. The case records the seed asked for, the seed used and every skipped seed with its determinant (case.json: extra.reseed). The seed used replaces the asked one everywhere: field, noise and probe draw
reseed.note: a determinant <= 0 is a fold. The margin is what a lattice cannot see between its points: over 240 bumps25 seeds at n_px (seeds 3000000 to 3000239, measured 2026-10-11) the smallest determinant fell by 0.008 to 0.046 (median 0.022) from an 8 px to a 4 px lattice, and on four seeds near zero by 0.006 to 0.010 more at 2 px, so above 0.05 at 4 px no fold is left between lattice points. Of those 240 seeds 1 had a determinant <= 0 at 4 px and 5 (2 %) were not above 0.05; all 5 would be skipped. The 12 frozen synthetic cases of the listed families are far above it (0.25 to 1.0) and none is re-seeded. seams is discontinuous on purpose (a negative jump at a seam is an overlap by design) and is not listed. step is a prime above every seed a seed_rule can ask for (the largest is under 1.1e8), so a re-seeded case never takes the seed another case asks for, and two re-seeded cases share a seed only if they asked for the same one

synthetic.seed_rule: scene = scene_seed + 100 * family index; round = scene + 1 + pose index

semisynth.patients_from: the cohort's own list: every patient of the manifest given to `prepare semisynth --truth --manifest`, or a declared subset of it; the list used is written beside the cases as truth_patients.json and is not part of this spec
semisynth.image: the patient's reference round, nuclear channel, before registration
semisynth.windows: the windows_per_patient non-overlapping n_px windows with most tissue (semisynth.pick_windows)
semisynth.seed_rule: seed + 1000 * (crc32(patient) % 100000) + 100 * window + 10 * family index + pose index
